text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hair and tail care, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Rainy days are especially 
bad! Both my hair and my tail end up 
totally frizzy and unkempt.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, your hair gets frizzy in the 
humidity, huh? In that case, the stuff I 
use might not work for you...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What is Flash-senpai doing?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I order mine directly from my hometown. I 
use it with the exact same brewing time, 
the same weight in grams, and the same 
water temperature."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That precise!? I knew there had to be 
a reason behind such a gorgeous coat!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But with how careless I am, there's 
no way I could ever...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. When it comes to simple and 
effective care suited to your hair type...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, come to think of it, earlier in the 
dorm lobby, Vilbros-san was—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, another new hair treatment? You 
really are so good at finding these."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone on social media is recommending 
it♪ It's super easy, just apply it! Works 
for any hair type! Hey, Sis, let's use it 
together~♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"All right. Let's start by reading the 
instruction manual together. If we use it 
wrong, it might not be as effective."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: “That's my Big Sis! So reliable~♡”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, in front of the 
station, I also—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for making the salon reservation 
for me, Big Sis~♡"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"You wanted the all-inclusive course with 
both a facial and head spa, right?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna do eveeeerything with Big Sis♡ 
Let's go on a date once our hair is super 
sleek and shiny♡"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see! Leaving it to the pros is an option 
too! ...Wait, no! But before, at this 
place—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Guess what? They say if you comb your 
hair with this, it gets super silky and 
glossy!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Hey, big sis, do it, do it~!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I saw someone doing that! Even if it's 
not a pro, having someone else do it—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...No, or rather...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um..., it certainly seems like you've got 
your hands full with various things, 
butâ

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. The true secret is surely...
Big sis~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, let's take a bath together today 
too! ♡ And dry my hair for me afterwards, 
okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Hehe, you really are such a 
spoiled baby.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Not just with anyone! Only because it's 
big sister♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The way she gently combs through it, and 
carefully dries it with a hairdryer...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Every single thing about you, Big Sis, is 
so warm and lovely, and I love you so 
much! ♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...What a helpless child you are. Fine 
then, come here."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Yeah, I don't think we could 
really use that as a reference~

Walking into the trainer's office, 
Vivlos's hair and tail seem to shine even 
brighter than usual today—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's up, Trainy? You're staring 
right at me.
choice_data_list:
No, it's just... you look kinda sparkly 
today

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right, right?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister took care of it for me! I felt 
so much of your love, Big Sister♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for being with me~, and making me 
look so pretty~! I loooove you too, Big 
Sis♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ I'm gonna ask you for a favor again 
today~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If we can, let's catch Cheval-chi too~ and 
become three silky, glossy-haired sisters♪

And so today, once again, the sight of 
harmonious sisters could be seen at the 
Ritto Dorms.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She's super nice, isn't she? So yeah, take 
a look—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Fufu♪

I was captivated for a moment by the sight 
of her hair and tail fluttering so 
beautifully.
